units.source_text: 町子上到了二楼客席的窗外。

en.t: Machiko had climbed up to the window outside the second floor audience seats.

units.source_text: 窗子被黑幕遮得严严密密。

en.t: The window was completely covered by a black curtain.

units.source_text: 从幕布的缝隙可以窥见微亮的土间。

en.t: Through a gap in the curtain, one could glimpse the faintly lit earthen floor.

units.source_text: 钢琴的声响，流向那没有人影的摞起来的椅子那边。

en.t: The sound of the piano drifted toward the stacked chairs where no one could be seen.

units.source_text: 这钢琴弹的是排练舞蹈的曲子。

en.t: The piano was playing music for a dance rehearsal.
